summary: Reviews By status no longer mixes the user's own open pull requests with other people's in one Waiting on others group. The 'waiting' group id is replaced by two (src/shared/pull-request-groups.ts): 'yours' (Your pull requests: open PRs the viewer authored that are not in Needs you or Ready, so waiting for review, checks running, a draft, approvals pending) and 'reviewing' (Reviewing: someone else's open PR the viewer is part of that is not in Needs you, so you reviewed, you commented, merge conflicts or checks running on their side). Order: Needs you, Ready to merge, Your pull requests, Reviewing, Merged this week; newest update first inside a group, as before. By repository keeps its rows in the same order, so a repository whose first row is your waiting PR now comes before one you only review, and Ready rows now come before your other waiting PRs inside a repository. Needs you, Ready and the hidden-PR comes-back rule (keyed on Needs you only) are unchanged. The demo adapter gains ssg-doctor #42, someone else's PR the viewer commented on, so the Reviews screens show both groups.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: mobile-v0.5.0, with the Reviews tab. apps/mobile has no pull request list and nothing there reads a group id, so nothing changes on the phone today; the Reviews tab will group with the same groupPullRequests and get both groups.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android 0.6.0, with the Reviews destination. No Android code reads pull requests or the group ids; nothing unfinished is reachable.

storageDataMigration.reason: Group ids are computed on every render and never stored: the persisted Reviews settings are the group-by mode and collapsed repository keys, and hides are keyed by PR, so nothing refers to the removed 'waiting' id.

updateRelease.reason: No wire, package, signing or update channel change. The grouping runs in the renderer over the unchanged PrSummary list, so any renderer/backend version pair works.

automated: vitest: your PR waiting for review with no reviewers, your draft, checks running and short of approvals are Your pull requests; someone else's PR you commented on, reviewed, with checks running or with conflicts is Reviewing; groups come in the order Needs you, Ready, Your pull requests, Reviewing, Merged, newest first inside; By repository puts a repository with your waiting PR ahead of one you only commented on; a hidden PR in either new group stays hidden when it changes.
Visual regressions (screens phase) re-recorded for the Reviews screens and run twice without updating.
notExercised: Not checked against a real account with ~26 repositories; only the demo data.
React Native and native Android are staged; nothing was run on a phone.
